newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia H1 copper concentrate output up 26.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia H1 copper concentrate output up 26.3 pct.

text.p: Mongolian copper concentrate production reached 224,400 tonnes in the first half of this year, up 26.3 percent from 177,700 tonnes in the same period of 1996, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Tuesday.
However, exports of copper concentrate in the six months of this year fell 20.2 percent to 211,100 tonnes from 264,600 tonnes in the year-ago period.
The bulletin gave no further details.
